response.passage: In the small town of Rampur, electricity supply was inconsistent until 2012. Mr. Sharma, the local engineer, observed that the frequent power cuts were caused by the heavy load on the old transformer during the peak evening hours. When the sun sets, every household turns on their lights and fans simultaneously, which forces the transformer to overheat and shut down. In 2015, the government installed a new, high-capacity transformer to handle this surge. Ms. Gupta, the district collector, inaugurated the system, noting that the upgrade was essential for the town's growth. Since then, the residents of Rampur have enjoyed stable power. However, some villagers still believe that the transformer shuts down because the wind blows too hard against the wires. Mr. Sharma explains that the wind is merely a result of the cooling fans inside the unit, not the cause of the power failure. He often reminds the youth that while the new machine is powerful, it still requires regular maintenance to prevent future outages.
response.summary: Rampur faced frequent power cuts due to an overloaded transformer during peak evening hours. In 2015, the government installed a new transformer to solve this issue. The town now enjoys stable electricity thanks to this upgrade and proper maintenance.
